column8: OboParser loads each alt_id twice - addSynonyms(term, altIds, "alt_id") and addXrefs(term, altIds).  This maps the synonym, which is how a secondary id becomes searchable; the duplicate xref is not reproduced (one predicate maps to one field).

Exactly what stock HumanMine loads: OboParser reads `xref`, and OboConverter.createXref builds an OntologyTerm with that identifier and adds it to crossReferences.  The collection holds OntologyTerm, not CrossReference, so xref ids like Reactome:REACT_28392 become identifier-only OntologyTerms - that is the stock behaviour this replaces, not a side effect.
obo source stores each synonym with its scope in OntologyTermSynonym.type
column21: Low number of red blood cells or hemoglobin

column8: e.g. GO:0044255 - exactly what the obo source stores in identifier.  The filter is not cosmetic: OBO ontologies give oboinowl:id to OWL object and annotation properties as well as to classes, so a full GO extract yields 11 rows whose "identifier" is a relationship name - part_of, occurs_in, regulates, ends_during, happens_during, starts_during, has_part, positively_regulates, negatively_regulates, has_ontology_root_term, term_tracker_item. They loaded as GOTerms and sorted to the top of the class in the UI.  Requiring the PREFIX:digits shape keeps every real term (GO:, HP:, MP:, UBERON:) and drops these; the column is required=yes, so a failing row is dropped rather than blanked.
OboParser never reads `comment`, and OntologyTerm has no field for it (description holds the definition)

column8: is_a parents (obo source fills OntologyTerm.parents).  The filter runs on the raw term, before the transform, and is not optional: in OWL, rdfs:subClassOf also points at anonymous class expressions (owl:Restriction, "part_of some X").  A full GO extract returns 92,208 superclass rows of which 16,178 are blank nodes and 3 are owl:Thing; without the filter iri_localname turned each blank node into a GOTerm whose identifier was its node id, adding 16k junk parents.  Restricting to the OBO namespace keeps legitimate cross-ontology parents (BFO, CARO), which still arrive as identifier-only stub items - filter harder if unwanted.
oboinowl:id carries the identifier; the IRI is redundant
